incident-bot: [PAGER] Elevated 5xx error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 on prod. Error class: 5xx (segfault/oom suspected). Priority: P1. Paging oncall.
oncall-ryan: picking up the pager. give me a quick summary of impact — are customers seeing failures or timeouts?
maria (support): multiple customer tickets coming in — some streaming connections cut with 502/504, others full requests returning 5xx. Customer A reports 30% failure rate starting ~09:12 UTC.
lucy (eng-runtime): I'm seeing model-runner processes dying on those hosts. Kernel OOPS/segfault in logs. Likely native crash in the optimized attention kernel after token ~1024.
sam (eng-sre): can you paste the crash log lines? also which node pool is affected?
lucy (eng-runtime): on nodes in pool inference-g4-usw2-2. Logs:
```
Mar 14 09:13:21 runner[pid=8743]: INFO start inference request id=abc123
Mar 14 09:13:22 runner[pid=8743]: ERROR runtime: segfault at 0x0000 ip 0x7f9a2eaf3b4 sp 0x7ffd3a2e
Mar 14 09:13:22 kernel: [  123.456789] kill pid=8743 (runner) total-vm: 2048000kB, anon-rss: 1500000kB, file-rss: 0kB
Mar 14 09:13:22 systemd: runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=11/SEGV
```
model-runner-bot: Auto-restarted runner on instance ip-10-0-12-45. Restart count: 3.
oncall-ryan: restarting loops are bad — circuit-break. Sam, can we put those instances into maintenance and drain traffic to avoid cascading failures?
sam (eng-sre): yes. I'll cordon + drain the nodes in the pool. Starting now: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-12-45` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data ip-10-0-12-45`.
ops-jen: heads-up, draining will trigger fallback routing to the cheaper model variant; latency will increase for some heavy customers.
akex (devex): typo on my name but okay :), note that downgrade variant doesn't support streaming so some clients will see truncated responses.
alex (devex): correcting: clients using streaming will get 504s until fallback supports streaming; suggest we enable model-level fallback that preserves streaming temporarily.
lucy (eng-runtime): quick mitigation we can do now: lower max_batch_size and disable the new fused-attention code path via env var to avoid the segfaulting kernel. We need to push config to the runner group.
oncall-ryan: do it. lucy, what's the env var and command?
lucy (eng-runtime): set `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` and restart the runner process. Example:
```
kubectl set env deploy/model-runner RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner -n prod
```
sam (eng-sre): applying node drain now. Draining ip-10-0-12-45 -> pod evicted. Scaling up fallback pool to absorb traffic: `kubectl scale deployment/model-runner-fallback --replicas=8 -n prod`.
model-runner-bot: Env var set on deployment/model-runner. Triggering rollout.
oncall-ryan: lucy, how long do we expect to see improvements after disabling fused attention?
lucy (eng-runtime): should be immediate for new pods after restart. Existing crashed pods won't recover. It mitigates the segfault but may increase CPU and memory per request ~+10-15%.
maria (support): flagging high-value customers: Customer A, B, and C on managed dedicated — they're impacted. Notifying account reps.
kelsey (product): prioritize Customer A mitigation — they are on dedicated and SLA is at risk. Any ETA to full recovery?
lucy (eng-runtime): if disable+restart works, we should see error rates drop to baseline within 5-10 minutes as new pods serve. For full root cause we'll need a debug build and core dumps to analyze.
sam (eng-sre): error rate snapshot before mitigation: 5xx spike to 28% across the region at 09:14. After initial drains & fallback scaling, dropping to ~12% at 09:20.
oncall-ryan: monitoring the dashboard. I've opened a temporary incident page with status updates.
model-runner-bot: New pod started: model-runner-5f7c8d9; readiness probe passed.
lucy (eng-runtime): I'm attaching a temporary build that has extra checks to avoid null pointer in attention kernel. We'll roll it to a small canary of 2 pods to validate.
oncall-ryan: canary sounds good. Route 5% traffic to canary.
sam (eng-sre): routing rule applied. Canary pods in ready state.
lucy (eng-runtime): canary logs look clean so far. No segfaults after 30 requests. increasing to 20%.
maria (support): customers still see intermittent 502s, but severity reduced. I'm sending a templated status email to impacted customers with ETA ~30 minutes.
kelsey (product): include note that this is an inference runtime crash tied to a new kernel path, mitigation includes disabling fused attention and rolling canary. We're working on a patch.
oncall-ryan: update: error rate down to 3% at 09:35. Major regressions mitigated. I'll keep the incident open until stable for 1 hour.
ops-jen: reminder — we need to capture core dumps and upload to artifact store for postmortem. Lucy, can you enable `ulimit -c unlimited` and preserve the crashed containers' filesystem? Sam, coordinate nodes not to auto-delete core files.
lucy (eng-runtime): enabling core dumps and increased log level. Added postmortem task to collect `/var/crash/*` and `dmesg` output.
alex (devex): docs update: adding a runbook entry for fused-attention toggle and guidance for fallback routing. I'll PR to docs repo.
model-runner-bot: Autoscaler: scaled fallback pool to 8 -> 5 (downscale) as CPU load decreased.
oncall-ryan: summary for incident channel: cause = segfault from fused attention kernel in optimized runtime causing process OOM/SEGV; mitigation = cordon/drain affected nodes, disable fused attention, scale fallback, canary patched build rolled -> stable. Customer impact: transient 5xx for some customers, high at spike ~09:14, now reduced. Next steps: collect cores, root cause analysis, fix kernel/fusion code, postmortem + customer follow-up.
lucy (eng-runtime): assigning follow-ups: runtime team to root cause and patch (owner: lucy). SRE to review autoscaler and drain behavior (owner: sam). Support to follow up with impacted customers (owner: maria). Postmortem draft due EOD.
sam (eng-sre): agree. I'll include timeline + metrics from alerting and actions taken.
maria (support): sending follow-up messages to affected customers now.
oncall-ryan: thanks everyone. I'll reassign page rotation. Closing page for now but keeping this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P1 updated: mitigated, monitoring. Incident channel will stay open for postmortem items.
